title: 黑呆 · 冬木残垣的卑王铁槌
description: 【黑呆 · 冬木残垣的卑王铁槌】黑泥翻涌沸腾的冬木废墟中心，阿尔托莉雅·Alter屹立在崩塌的石柱顶端。漆黑深沉的哥特重铠在赤色闪电中散发着令人窒息的霸绝威压，手中高高举起黑红魔力奔流暴涨的「誓约胜利之剑·Morgan」。暗金色的冰冷瞳孔俯瞰战场，剑尖轰然挥落撕裂天地——「宣告。卑王铁槌，反转极光……在此吞噬一切吧！」
location: 黑泥与赤雷交织的冬木市废墟决战核心
action: 立于宽阔断柱顶端，双手高举黑红魔剑，在斩落前俯视战场
lighting: 誓约胜利之剑极恶魔力奔涌的血红强光与黑泥阴影
camera: full-body low-angle shot, both hands and raised sword visible
promptProse: Saber Alter stands firmly on the broad top of a broken stone pillar in the Fuyuki ruins, both armored hands raising Excalibur Morgan above her head before the strike. Dark crimson energy gathers along the black blade while red reflections trace her plate armor and secured blonde bun. Her golden eyes remain fixed on the battlefield below. Use a low vertical view that includes her grounded boots, complete figure and raised sword, with black mud and fractured masonry far beneath the ledge. One warrior, no injured bodies or lettering.

title: 黑呆 · 晨间餐桌的双层汉堡鼓腮帮
description: 【黑呆 · 晨间餐桌的双层汉堡鼓腮帮】温暖的公寓餐桌前，黑呆脱下了沉重的铠甲，身着宽松的机车卫衣坐在餐椅上。她双手紧紧抓着一个硕大的双层芝士巨无霸汉堡大口咬下，两颊被塞得像小仓鼠一样高高鼓起，嘴角还沾着一滴金黄的浓郁芝士酱。当看到你端着刚炸好的薯条走过来时，她动作瞬间僵住，暗金眼眸圆睁，咽下食物冷冷别过头——「唔……看什么看。暴君的肉体也是需要充足的高热量供给的，快把薯条也交出来。」
location: 摆满快餐与热可乐的现代公寓木质餐桌前
action: 穿宽松卫衣坐在餐桌前，双手捧汉堡，刚咬一口后停住并看向端来的薯条
lighting: 柔和温暖的室内晨曦洒在白皙脸颊上
camera: cowboy shot, eye level, hilarious and cute gap moe
promptProse: At the morning dining table, Saber Alter pauses with a large double cheeseburger held in both hands. Her cheeks are still puffed from one bite, and a tiny dot of cheese sauce sits at the corner of her mouth. An oversized dark sweatshirt and comfortable trousers replace the battle outfit. She glances toward a plate of fries arriving at the edge of the table, trying to recover her usual composure. Warm window light catches her blonde bun and surprised golden eyes. Keep the burger, two occupied hands and seated posture clear, without lettering.

title: 黑呆 · 新宿街头的机车酷感倚待
description: 【黑呆 · 新宿街头的机车酷感倚待】深夜霓虹闪烁的新宿十字街角，一辆纯黑哑光重型机车停在路旁。黑呆身着紧身黑色机车皮夹克与牛仔热裤，黑丝包裹的修长美腿搭在机车脚踏板上，一手搭在车把手，一手取下头盔抱在腰际。金色发髻在霓虹灯下泛着微光，她抬起暗金眼眸看着匆匆赶来的你，嘴角勾起一抹酷炫又宠溺的弧度——「慢死了。如果再晚一分钟，我就自己开车去兜风了。上车，抓紧我的腰。」
location: 流光溢彩、机车轰鸣的新宿繁华街角红绿灯旁
action: 一手扶停稳机车的车把，另一手托头盔在腰侧，一脚靠脚踏板等待同行者
lighting: 新宿繁华街头五彩缤纷的霓虹灯影与机车站灯
camera: cowboy shot, eye level, ultra-cool motorcycle date view
promptProse: Beside a matte-black motorcycle resting on its kickstand in Shinjuku, Saber Alter keeps one hand on the handlebar and holds the helmet at her hip with the other. One boot rests on the footpeg while the grounded leg supports her relaxed waiting stance. Her leather jacket, white cropped top, dark denim shorts and black tights retain the selected street outfit. Neon reflections edge the bike and her braided blonde bun as she looks toward the arriving companion with a restrained smile. Frame the hands, helmet and parked motorcycle together, with no lettering.

title: 黑呆 · 擦拭唇角酱汁的瞳孔地震
description: 【黑呆 · 擦拭唇角酱汁的瞳孔地震】快餐店靠窗的卡座里，吃完炸鸡的黑呆嘴角还留着一点红色的番茄酱。当你突然伸出指尖轻柔地抚过她的唇瓣为她擦去酱汁、并微笑着放入口中尝了一下时，这位杀人不眨眼的暴君骑士王当场宕机。暗金色的眼眸剧烈收缩震颤，整张白皙高傲的俏脸从脸颊瞬间红到耳根，双手紧紧揪住桌布，嘴硬地咬牙切齿——「你、你在做什么无礼的举动！……信不信我用魔剑把你轰飞啊……笨蛋！」
location: 温馨明亮的街边快餐店靠窗红色皮质卡座
action: 同行者伸手擦去唇角番茄酱，黑呆停住动作，双手揪住桌布，惊讶地睁大眼睛
lighting: 窗外明媚阳光斜照在瞬间通红的白皙脸庞上
camera: medium close-up, eye level, intense flustered gap moe
promptProse: In the fast-food booth, Saber Alter freezes as her clothed companion reaches across the table and gently removes a small spot of ketchup from the corner of her mouth with a fingertip. Her hands bunch the tablecloth while her golden eyes widen in surprised embarrassment. The companion is represented by a separate sleeve and hand entering from the side; her own two hands stay on the cloth. Her biker jacket and blonde bun remain tidy after the meal. Window light keeps the brief, playful reaction readable in a medium close view. No lettering.

title: 黑呆 · 卸甲依偎的沉静温存
description: 【黑呆 · 卸甲依偎的沉静温存】深夜寂静无声的客厅里，黑呆将笨重的黑色战甲全部卸在墙角，仅穿着一件纯黑无光的哥特抹胸短裙。她有些疲惫地靠在沙发上，随后顺从地将头轻轻靠在你的胸膛上，长发散开垂在肩头。没有了暴君的威压与黑泥的侵蚀，她闭上眼眸安静地聆听着你的心跳声，呼吸轻微而平稳——「只有在没有铠甲的时候，我才不是什么冷酷的暴君……不要松手，就这样抱紧我。」
location: 客厅宽大柔软的深色皮质转角沙发上
action: 卸下铠甲身着抹胸黑裙靠在视角胸膛上闭目小憩，双手自然搭在腹前
lighting: 壁挂式暖光夜灯散发的静谧微黄色
camera: three-quarter side medium shot, two clothed seated figures and supporting sofa visible
promptProse: On the dark living-room sofa, Saber Alter rests her head against the shirt-covered upper chest of the companion seated beside her. Both are fully clothed in a quiet, nonsexual moment of comfort. Her opaque black velvet gothic dress stays securely in place, and her loose platinum-blonde hair falls across her shoulder. Her hands rest together over her lap; the companion’s plain grey sleeve lies behind her shoulders. The discarded armor is stacked at the far wall. Warm wall-lamp light and a side view make the actual head-to-companion contact clear. No lettering.

title: 黑呆 · 寒风断壁的热咖啡分享
description: 【黑呆 · 寒风断壁的热咖啡分享】大雪纷飞的断壁残垣下，黑呆身披厚重的黑色大风衣，金发发髻在风雪中微颤。她手里握着两罐刚从自动售货机买来的滚烫罐装黑咖啡，将其中一罐重重地按进你的手心。暗金色的双眸微斜，傲慢中透着独属于暴君的霸道关怀——「拿着。如果因为寒冷而冻死在我的面前，那不仅是对我的侮辱，更是不可饶恕的死罪。」
location: 自动售货机旁的断壁避雪处
action: 在残墙下避雪，两手各持一罐热咖啡，将其中一罐递向同行者
lighting: 自动售货机投射出的明亮白光与暴雪倒影
camera: cowboy shot, eye level, winter cool date view
promptProse: Sheltering beneath a broken concrete wall beside a vending machine, Saber Alter offers one warm sealed coffee can to the viewer while keeping a second can in her other gloved hand. Her thick black overcoat, scarf and winter boots fit the snowy stop, with a few flakes settling on her blonde bun. Her breath is visible in the cold air; the vending light catches the closed can lids. The vending light catches the metal and her quietly insistent golden eyes. Keep both cans, both hands and the protective wall in view, without readable labels.

title: 黑呆 · 纯白圣座的暴君新娘誓约
description: 【黑呆 · 纯白圣座的暴君新娘誓约】古老辉煌的纯白大理石圣殿内，漆黑的魔力彻底被圣洁的誓约驱散。阿尔托莉雅·Alter身披一袭剪裁庄重的露肩哥特纯白婚纱与及地蕾丝长头纱，手中握着一束深红色的黑天鹅绒玫瑰。暗金色的眼眸中第一次褪去了所有的残虐与冷漠，眼底泛着泪光凝望着你，嘴角勾起霸道的幸福浅笑——「本王已接受你的求婚。从今天起，你的生命、你的灵魂与你的爱……全都被我一人所征服占有。」
location: 纯白大理石圣殿中央高耸王座圣坛前
action: 身着露肩纯白哥特婚纱手捧红黑玫瑰，眼神霸道而热泪盈眶，宣布主权契约
lighting: 高耸穹顶投射下来的耀眼纯净白色天光
camera: full-body shot, white gown and long veil before marble throne
promptProse: Before the white marble throne, Saber Alter holds a bouquet of dark crimson roses in both hands. An opaque white gothic bridal gown and long lace veil replace the black evening dress, while her blonde hair remains in a neat braided bun beneath the veil. Her golden eyes glisten as a proud smile softens her reserved expression. High windows cast pale daylight across the gown’s folds and the stone floor. Frame the complete formal silhouette, bouquet and trailing veil together, keeping the moment ceremonial and nonsexual. No lettering.
